mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the 3-month Treasury yield indicates central bank easing, which lowers discount rates and increases present value of equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the 3-month Treasury yield signals tightening monetary policy, which raises discount rates and compresses equity present value, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) suggests weakening labor market demand, which reduces corporate hiring and future earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in softening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
